cases.name: root selectors become :scope; names that only contain them stay
cases.css: body { margin: 0; } html, body { height: 100%; } tbody { top: 0; } .some-body { color: blue; } #body { left: 0; } :root { --ident: body; }
cases.inner: :scope { margin: 0; } :scope, :scope { height: 100%; } tbody { top: 0; } .some-body { color: blue; } #body { left: 0; } :scope { --ident: body; }

cases.name: root selectors are remapped only in selector position
cases.css: @keyframes body { from { opacity: 0; } } a[rel=html] { color: red; } div:not(body) > html { color: blue; }
cases.inner: @keyframes body { from { opacity: 0; } } a[rel=html] { color: red; } div:not(:scope) > :scope { color: blue; }

cases.name: surrounding CSS whitespace is trimmed
a no-break space is part of a name, not whitespace to trim
a leading stray } is dropped
a stray } after a rule is dropped
an unclosed block is closed
unclosed nested blocks and parentheses are closed innermost first
an unterminated string is terminated before the block is closed
an unterminated comment is terminated
an unterminated url() token is terminated before the block is closed
a trailing backslash is kept; the wrapper closes on the next line
a } inside a string is not structure
an escaped backslash does not escape the closing quote
backslash CR LF inside a string is one escaped newline
#url( is a hash token followed by parentheses
@url( is an at-keyword followed by parentheses
a longer name ending in url is a function
url spelled with an escape is a url() token
a no-break space does not separate url( from a quote
a dimension whose unit is url is not a url() token
a function whose name ends in url keeps its block structure
url( followed by a quoted string is a function
an unquoted url() token and signed numbers are copied verbatim
cases.css: .a { background: url(  x.png  ); margin: -1.5e3px +.5em 1e+3px; } .b { color: blue; }
cases.inner: .a { background: url(  x.png  ); margin: -1.5e3px +.5em 1e+3px; } .b { color: blue; }

cases.name: the end tag of the style element is escaped, in any letter case
a block scoped to another selector is wrapped like any other rule
several stray } in a row are all dropped
a stray } after a nested @scope block is dropped
a stray } between group rules is dropped and the group left open is closed
a { inside an unquoted url() token is not structure
a } inside an unquoted url() token is not structure
an escaped } in a selector is not structure
a } inside a comment is not structure
an escaped quote does not end a string
a newline ends an unterminated string; the } after it is structure
a } inside an open parenthesis is an ordinary token
an end tag of the style element outside a string is escaped
an end tag of the style element with a space before > is escaped
a statement at-rule is copied as written
